summary: Bulk edit on Lines throws an error
reported_issue: Selecting multiple Lines and using the gyros (3-dot) menu to change them in bulk threw: 'Could not resolve the App\\VehicleService\\WorkOrders\\Application\\Line\\ChangeLines\\ChangeCommand class', masking the real error SQLSTATE[42S22]: Column not found: 1054 Unknown column 'pr.part_request_type' in 'where clause'.
expected_after_fix: Bulk-editing selected lines (e.g. Set line status) completes successfully without a 500/ChangeCommand/SQL error.
steps_i_followed: Opened WO S9-24938 (2 lines) on the Lines tab
Selected all lines via the header select-all checkbox
Opened the table-header gyros (3-dot) menu -> confirmed bulk options: 'Set line status', 'Delete lines', 'Split work order'
Chose Set line status -> Authorized to perform a bulk status change while capturing the network response
actual_now: The bulk change fired POST /api/work-orders/lines/change-lines which returned HTTP 201 with body {"data":[]} (success). The line statuses updated and no error toast, no 'Could not resolve ... ChangeCommand' message, and no SQL 'Unknown column pr.part_request_type' error appeared.
notes: The bulk change-lines endpoint now returns 201 instead of the previously reported 500. Tested on disposable staging WO S9-24938 under the ZZAUTOTEST customer.
